outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented rendering derived from cryo-electron tomography showing preconoidal rings and an actin filament; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented tomographic rendering of cytoplasmic actin bundles and pellicular actin; it is a structural reconstruction, not a plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with traced filaments highlighted in green and a scale bar; it presents no averaged/quantitative plot data.
Panel D is a schematic/3D rendering illustrating nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular F-actin structures; it does not plot averaged measurements.
Panel E is a tomographic slice image of an averaged structural volume (subtomogram average) with a scale bar; it is a micrograph-type image, not a data plot with means/error bars.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament-myosin connection observed in two locations (N=2), with a scale bar; it is not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
